en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall spired towers rising above trees and stone walls. In the foreground there is an open‑air theatre with curved rows of stone or concrete seating. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text at the top left, handwritten Hungarian message in blue ink, a Hungarian postage stamp, and a round postmark dated 1967.
